name: Kanto in Motion
description: Kanto in Motion multi-generation HD Pokemon presentation and battle overhaul. Supports Red/Blue/Yellow, Gold/Silver/Crystal, and FireRed/LeafGreen; Gen 1 keeps the full KIM battle/UI stack, Gen 2 adds KIM Modern UI presentation while retaining native battle logic and HP/status HUD behavior, and Gen 3 keeps its native UI systems.
